items.exampleEn: All cats are animals, but the converse is not true: not all animals are cats.
items.exampleZh: 所有的貓都是動物，但反過來就不成立：並非所有動物都是貓。

items.exampleEn: This film has subtitles in twelve languages.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影有十二種語言的字幕。

items.exampleEn: A huge number of photos are shared in cyberspace every day.
items.exampleZh: 每天都有大量的照片在網路世界裡被分享。

items.exampleEn: We pay quite a lot for our home broadband every month.
items.exampleZh: 我們每個月家裡的寬頻網路要付不少錢。

items.exampleEn: The leaflet explains how to recycle old batteries.
items.exampleZh: 這張傳單說明怎麼回收舊電池。

items.exampleEn: Children usually become more communicative when they feel safe.
items.exampleZh: 孩子覺得安全的時候，通常會變得比較願意溝通。

items.exampleEn: The orator's voice filled the whole hall without a microphone.
items.exampleZh: 那位演說家沒用麥克風，聲音就傳遍了整個大廳。

items.sentenceEn: The hotel offers free broadband in every room.
items.sentenceZh: 這家飯店每間房都提供免費寬頻網路。

items.audioEn: The museum is closed on Mondays, the leaflet says, so let's go on Tuesday.
items.audioZh: 傳單上說博物館星期一休館，所以我們星期二去吧。
items.questionZh: 說話者建議哪天去博物館？
options: On Monday, like the leaflet says

items.sentenceEn: Please don't leave leaflets on the cars in this street.
items.sentenceZh: 請不要把傳單放在這條街的車子上。

items.sentenceEn: In cyberspace, people sometimes say things they would never say face to face.
items.sentenceZh: 在網路世界裡，人們有時會說出當面絕對不會說的話。

items.stemEn: Everyone agreed that he was a brilliant ____; his speeches made crowds cry and cheer.
items.stemZh: 大家都認為他是一位傑出的演說家；他的演講讓群眾又哭又歡呼。

items.stemEn: Our new manager is very ____ and always explains her decisions to the team.
items.stemZh: 我們的新經理很善於溝通，總是向團隊解釋她的決定。

items.passageEn: Our town wanted more people to use its new online services, so it held a public talk. The town printed hundreds of leaflets and also posted the news in cyberspace, on social media and local websites. The speaker was a retired teacher and a famous orator. He explained that fast broadband is now available nationwide, even in small mountain villages. He also encouraged people to read and write more online. He said that good readers often become good writers, and the converse is also true: people who write a lot become better readers. The talk was recorded, and people who missed it can now watch the video with subtitles.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上想讓更多人使用新的線上服務，所以舉辦了一場公開演講。鎮公所印了幾百張傳單，也把消息貼到網路世界裡，包括社群媒體和地方網站。講者是一位退休老師，也是知名的演說家。他說明現在全國都有快速的寬頻網路，連小山村也有。他也鼓勵大家多在網路上閱讀和寫作。他說，會讀書的人常常也很會寫作，反過來也成立：常寫作的人也會變得更會閱讀。這場演講有錄影，錯過的人現在可以看附字幕的影片。

questions.questionZh: 鎮上用什麼方式宣傳這場演講？
講者說了什麼和讀寫有關的事？
options: 常寫作的人也會更會閱讀
只有年輕人才喜歡閱讀

items.promptZh: 我看韓劇的時候都會開中文字幕。
referenceEn: I always turn on Chinese subtitles when I watch Korean dramas.
When I watch Korean dramas, I always use Chinese subtitles.
rubricZh: 字幕用複數（例如 subtitles 等）
「開字幕」可寫，例如 turn on subtitles、use subtitles、watch with subtitles 等
說習慣，時態合理（例如 turn on、watch 等）

items.promptZh: 這門課的重點是溝通能力，而不是文法。
referenceEn: This course focuses on communicative skills, not grammar.
The focus of this course is communicative skills rather than grammar.
rubricZh: communicative 這裡表示「溝通的」，放名詞前（例如 communicative skills 等）
「重點是」可寫，例如 focuses on、the focus is… 等
「而不是」可寫，例如 not、rather than、instead of 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：自評疑慮判定：單字卡 the converse（貓／動物）用法正確可保留；但短文 'the converse is often true' 是把 converse 當「相反」用，嚴格說「網路讓人較不善溝通」的反面應是 the opposite／the reverse，converse 指命題倒置。屬寬鬆用法，疑似會讓學習者學到不精確的語感，建議改 'the opposite is often true' 或改寫成真正的倒置命題。
